CATALOGUED_FRAGMENTS: Accidental collision between a derelict U.S. Thor Burner 2A upper-stage rocket body and a fragment from the third stage of a Chinese CZ-4 launch vehicle. NASA reports the debris fragment had a radar cross-section of 600 cm², the collision occurred at 885 km, and the relative velocity was just under 6 km/s. NASA reports fewer than 10 cataloged debris were produced.
NOTES: NASA Orbital Debris Quarterly News, April 2005; NASA History of On-Orbit Satellite Fragmentations
